# hiok_subnet (Resource)

A subnet of a virtual network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `vnet_id` (String) The virtual network's id.

### Optional

- `address_space` (String) The network's address space, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16.
- `ip_range` (String) The subnet's range, e.g. 10.0.1.0/24.
- `size` (String) Prefix length, e.g. /24.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `region_id` (String)
- `vnet_name` (String)
